env.//: A dev client still auto-detects the LAN IP, so nothing is set here.

preview.//: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is deliberately unset: src/config.ts throws at startup when nothing is configured, so a preview build cannot place real orders by accident. Set it to a staging API before building one, or to the production URL if you mean to test against live data.

production.//: The live API, and the R2 public host the images are served from (the API host 404s them, so an unset MEDIA_URL breaks every product image). Hard-coded rather than an EAS secret because both ship inside the bundle anyway. autoIncrement is set because the Play Store rejects a re-used versionCode. Android also needs GOOGLE_MAPS_ANDROID_API_KEY as an EAS environment variable, or the maps are blank; see app.config.js.
